sentences.en: Poulos-Davis-Randolph (PDR) Method is a empirical calculation method. It is easy to compute the relation between the number of piles and the average settlement of the foundation.

sentences.en: Although there were more PDR cases within the IDDM and insulin injection group, the total group number was too small as compared to the NIDDM and non-insulin injection group.

sentences.en: The PDR is a major milestone for spaceflight projects, allowing managers to check a spacecraft's design progress.

sentences.en: The PDR consisted of a government review and subsequent approval of the G/ATOR system and subsystem design for hardware and software including a program management review of cost and schedule.Sentencedict.com
sentences.vi: PDR bao gồm việc xem xét của chính phủ và phê duyệt sau đó đối với hệ thống G / ATOR và thiết kế hệ thống con cho phần cứng và phần mềm bao gồm việc xem xét quản lý chương trình về chi phí và lịch trình.

sentences.en: The PDR for Herbal Medicines states that licorice is contraindicated (use is inadvisable) in people with chronic hepatitis, cholestatic liver disease, and cirrhosis.
